scope: A receipt-bound local JPEG/PNG capture-quality workbench for the frozen Reception 18-build/12-held-out naming protocol. This slice is local reconstruction-product engineering. Cybersecurity, credentials, identity attestation, signing, cloud deployment and publication are excluded.

contract.heldoutUse: Capture-integrity and possible split-leakage checks only; held-out pixels are not build, tuning or selection inputs.

fixtureRun.qualification: These are exact copies of existing repository web photographs renamed into four protocol slots. They are not the real Reception 30-photo capture and make no finding about that capture.

boundaries: A pass means only that no frozen capture-quality heuristic fired.
capture_quality_ready means ready for a later registration test, not registered, reconstructed, approved or releasable.
Low edge energy can be caused by a textureless scene and always needs human review of the untouched original.
The report does not establish camera or lens calibration, physical accuracy, recovered detail, completeness, provenance, rights, privacy clearance, training permission or publication authority.
The self-digest is local consistency evidence, not a signature, trusted timestamp or identity attestation.
nextRealInput: An owned local folder containing the actual 18 build and 12 held-out JPEG/PNG captures named by docs/reports/reception-room-30-photo-capture-checklist.md, plus matching untouched RAW files or an explicit session note for each missing RAW counterpart.
